gloss: collection rate; recovery rate; retrieval rate

definitions.gloss: collection rate; recovery rate; retrieval rate
definitions.explanation: Used in contexts ranging from recycling to surveys to financial debt collection

examples.japanese: アンケートの{回収率|かいしゅうりつ}は80%だった。
ペットボトルの{回収率|かいしゅうりつ}を{上|あ}げる{取|と}り{組|く}み。
examples.english: Efforts to increase the plastic bottle recycling rate.

examples.japanese: この{地域|ちいき}では{資源|しげん}ごみの{回収率|かいしゅうりつ}が{全国|ぜんこく}{平均|へいきん}を{大|おお}きく{上回|うわまわ}っている。
examples.english: In this area, the recycling collection rate significantly exceeds the national average.

notes:
A compound of {回収|かいしゅう} (collection, recovery) + {率|りつ} (rate, ratio). The meaning shifts depending on context: in environmental/recycling contexts it means the percentage of materials successfully collected for recycling; in survey research it means the response rate; in finance it refers to the debt recovery rate.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {回収率|かいしゅうりつ}を{上|あ}げる: to raise the collection rate
- {回収率|かいしゅうりつ}が{高|たか}い: the collection rate is high
- アンケートの{回収率|かいしゅうりつ}: survey response rate
- リサイクル{回収率|かいしゅうりつ}: recycling collection rate

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {回答率|かいとうりつ}: response rate (specifically for questionnaires or surveys)
- {再利用率|さいりようりつ}: reuse rate (percentage of materials actually reused)
- {返却率|へんきゃくりつ}: return rate (for borrowed items or rentals)
